about: Scoda Tubes Ltd is a standalone, integrated manufacturer of stainless-steel seamless and welded pipes and tubes at Mehsana, Gujarat. Its portfolio includes seamless pipes, seamless tubes and U-tubes, instrumentation tubes and welded tubes and U-tubes serving oil & gas, chemicals, fertilisers, power, pharmaceuticals, automotive and railway applications.
